name: Tiefling
description: To be greeted with stares and whispers, to be treated with suspicion and fear, to be denied the comforts of home — this is the lot in life for the tiefling, born with the blood of fiends running through their veins, marked by their infernal heritage with horns, a tail, and eyes of solid color.

grants.name: Darkvision (60 ft)
grants.description: See in dim light within 60 ft. as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (no color, only shades of gray).

grants.name: Fiendish Legacy
grants.description: Choose the fiendish bloodline your infernal heritage traces to. It determines a cantrip you know and the spells you gain as you level, all cast with Charisma.

options.name: Abyssal
options.description: Cantrip: Poison Spray. At 3rd level, cast Ray of Sickness once per long rest; at 5th level, Hold Person once per long rest.

options.name: Chthonic
options.description: Cantrip: Chill Touch. At 3rd level, cast False Life once per long rest; at 5th level, Ray of Enfeeblement once per long rest.

options.name: Infernal
options.description: Cantrip: Fire Bolt. At 3rd level, cast Hellish Rebuke once per long rest; at 5th level, Darkness once per long rest.
